propositions: Configuration must resolve once per operation boundary using immutable OperationSnapshot with precedence: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default
Authentication must compose consistently across LLM, Git, bridge, MCP, review-bot, and op-cert without in-progress operations rereading ambient state or falling back to unintended identity

Provider-native auth/session capability must inject only through existing RP-01 ProviderSession builders while preserving budget, retry history, cache, accounting, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, and failure behavior
Static credentials must use provider-specific Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes carriers revealed only in sending adapter with no universal secret broker or global environment mutation

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker/network creation, and use process-owned 0700/0600 file copy with no runtime SSM/boto3 coupling

Portable AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject ambient reads and backend reloads below approved seams, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover
